report.clinical_summary: The patient has been living with HIV for several years and reports feeling 'really off' with general malaise, fatigue, brain fog, and occasional headaches. They are on antiretroviral medication that generally keeps things under control but struggle with adherence, especially on difficult days when they feel exhausted or emotionally overwhelmed. They've had to adjust their expectations of what they're capable of doing and carry significant uncertainty and worry about the future. They experience obsessive thoughts about medication effectiveness and whether they're making things worse by not being perfect with their regimen.
